questions.q: A carpenter buys wood for $40 and sells a finished chair for $150. What is the added value?
questions.why: Added value = selling price − cost of bought-in materials = 150 − 40.

questions.q: Which is a feature of a private limited company?
options: Shares are sold on the stock exchange
It is owned by the government
questions.why: Only a plc can sell shares on the stock exchange; a private limited company's shareholders have limited liability.

questions.q: Which business operates in the secondary sector?
questions.why: Secondary sector = manufacturing/processing; retail and banking are tertiary, fishing is primary.
